narrative_engine.thesis: Volatility is coiled (ATR percentile 5%, EMA spread -1.54 ATR) — the honest play is patience. Do NOT fade the range: compression resolves explosively, and the highest-value action is standing ready with the M1 pullback plan the moment a stack aligns.

athena_oracle.verdict: Neutral equilibrium 49/100 — trend aligned, flow fading, squeeze fuel overhead
